## What the door does (read on PR #28527's head)

- Since PR #28527 the door refuses a non-string `message` with 400 `VALIDATION_ERROR` naming `message`.
- A whole body that is not an object has no `message` to read, so the door still publishes with the default note and answers 200. `PublishPackageDraftsRequestSchema` would refuse that body as a whole.
- The PR body states this residual. The card's ruling named `message` only, so it was left as it was.

## Wanted (route is triage's)
